entities.name: Zdzisław Stieber
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdzisław Stieber was a Polish linguist and Slavist. He was born in Szczakowa, then part of the Austro-Hungarian province of Galicia. His family was of assimilated German descent in Poland for generations. He died in Warsaw.
